cover.title: The Cute Side of Life
cover.lead: Original characters and illustrations by **Naolito**, a 2D animation and illustration studio from Málaga, Spain. Built on social media, already sold worldwide and looking for licensing representation.

about.title: A small studio with a big, self-built audience
paragraphs: Naolito is a 2D animation and illustration studio based in Málaga, Spain, created by illustrator, animator and filmmaker **Nacho Arjona**. Since 2009 it has been building **The Cute Side of Life**: a universe of food, animals, planets and everyday objects living small, relatable moments.

The audience came first. Around 1.2 million people follow Naolito across social networks, and its designs have sold organically on 14+ platforms worldwide and in independent shops in Spain, Belgium, France and Italy.

We are not a global megabrand, and we do not pretend to be. We are a small studio with a proven, organic audience, a deep catalogue of finished artwork and an in-house animation team. We are looking for an agency to turn that demand into structured licensing programmes.

characters.title: Meet the cast of The Cute Side of Life
characters.lead: A recurring cast of foods, animals and planets with simple shapes, big eyes and one clear emotion each. They are easy to read at any size, from a pin to a duvet cover.

items.name: The Avocado family
items.desc: Parents and their baby pit. *Kindest Surprise* is Naolito's best-known design, and the family has a whole storyline (babycado, tired avocado).

items.name: Broccoli
items.desc: The lonely vegetable nobody likes. One of the most famous Naolito characters and the star of the animated short *Nobody likes me!* (5.5M views on TikTok).

items.name: Sun, Cloud & baby Rainbow
items.desc: A tender sky family. A natural fit for baby, family and Mother's and Father's Day products.

items.name: T-Rex
items.desc: A dinosaur who never quite wins. *Asteroid, Paper, Scissors* is one of the series' classics.

items.name: The Sushi gang
items.desc: Salmon, tofu and nigiri in love stories and sporting feats (*Sushi is Love*, *Sushi Olympics*).

items.name: Blue, the Earth
items.desc: A curious planet who explores the world. With Saturn, the Sun and the Moon, Blue already appears in 2D and in 3D shorts.

items.name: Before & After
items.desc: A series of characters before and after coffee, the gym or the shower. It sells as stickers, sweatshirts, prints and the Nesquik mugs.

items.name: Wallet
items.desc: A responsible little wallet, worried about the future and other adult stuff. A Naolito Originals character, animated in 3D.

universe.title: A catalogue of hundreds of finished designs
universe.lead: The Cute Side of Life has 12+ years of illustrations about everyday life: Mondays, coffee, the gym, summer heat, family and love. Most work with little or no text. Every image is original Naolito art, owned by the studio and ready to adapt.

cards.title: Why it travels
items: Visual gags with little or no text
Universal subjects: food, animals, weather, planets
Evergreen jokes that do not depend on trends
Built-in seasonal hooks: Mondays, summer heat, gym season, family days
Native to social media: every launch can come with animated content

categories.title: Product categories where we see potential
categories.lead: Based on what already sells on our platforms and with partners, plus a few next steps that suit the characters.

items.name: Apparel and sleepwear
items.why: T-shirts are our top seller on every platform (73 of 120 cards in our Redbubble shop). Next steps: pyjamas, kidswear, socks and loungewear.

items.name: Wall art and home décor
items.why: 122 metal posters on Displate, 46 canvases on iCanvas, and prints at DesignPlace. Also cushions, blankets and tapestries.

items.name: Mugs, tableware and kitchen
items.why: The Nesquik mug collection and best-selling mugs and coasters. Food characters fit kitchen, lunch boxes and bottles.

items.name: Stationery and back-to-school
items.why: Notebooks already sell on our platforms, and we have done brand work with Pilot. Also agendas, pencil cases and calendars.

items.name: Stickers, pins and small gifts
items.why: Stickers and enamel pins are steady sellers. Impulse-buy formats for design and gift shops.

items.name: Plush and collectibles
items.why: Simple, round characters with one clear emotion. Not produced yet: a natural next step for toy partners.

items.name: Greeting cards and gift wrap
items.why: Family, love and seasonal gags (Mother's Day, Valentine's Day, birthdays).

items.name: Publishing
items.why: Our first book came out with Lunwerg / Planeta in 2021. Next: picture books, activity books and gift books.

items.name: Promotions and food and beverage
items.why: Nesquik showed the fit: food characters for packaging, gift-with-purchase and in-store campaigns, with animation made by our own studio.

agency.title: What we are looking for in an agency
agency.lead: A medium-sized or boutique licensing agency that will actively build a programme for The Cute Side of Life, with clear targets from the start.
